failure_cases.must_fail_when: The handoff says old-file writes are allowed now.
The handoff allows immediate writing after approval without fresh prewrite checks.
The handoff omits the exact p2-75 approval prerequisite.
The handoff allows body content, artifact, tools, templates, wiki truth layer, or mainline edits.
The handoff omits rollback, path audit, or final gate requirements.
The handoff implies merge, promotion, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
The handoff claims the full goal is complete before old-file normalization is actually executed and verified.
